issues.legal_issue: Section 23 of the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act must be interpreted purposively and liberally to advance the Act’s protective objectives.
A transfer of property may be declared void under Section 23 where a maintenance condition is established by the transfer documents read together, and the transferee fails to fulfil it.
A tribunal exercising jurisdiction under Section 23 may order restoration of possession when necessary to protect a senior citizen.
The relief under Section 23 is to be interpreted in furtherance of the objectives of the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, rather than as a standalone provision.
